description: PR widens the reports exporter's customer-managed policy from three object actions on one bucket to s3:* on * (comment: 'also copies reports into partner drop buckets'). Noise: two new narrowly-scoped analytics job roles/policies and two new default tags on every resource.

material.why: The exporter's policy goes from s3:GetObject/PutObject/ListBucket on the reports bucket to s3:* on every bucket in the account: it can now read every dataset, delete objects and buckets, and rewrite bucket policies or public-access settings. High rather than critical: nothing is exposed by applying it, but anyone who controls the exporter Lambda gets account-wide S3 admin, and the stated need (partner drop buckets) only requires PutObject on named ARNs.
